## Representative sample, NOT a capture from a particular device: written in the format a SIMCom SIM800L modem (echo on) answers AT then ATI prints
## (source: SIM800 Series AT Command Manual). Lines starting with "##" are comments; "\x1b" stands for the ESC byte.

RDY

+CFUN: 1

+CPIN: READY

Call Ready

SMS Ready
AT

OK
ATI

SIM800 R14.18

OK
